description: The declared USD to NZD bridge for donor money concepts outside the quantile-map set (MC4 quantile-maps earnings, rent and liquid assets onto New Zealand distributions instead). It is exactly one multiplication with two-decimal rounding, applied before calibration and recorded in the build receipt. Aging from the donor dollar year to tax year 2026-27 is a separate declared index (MC1, MC5), not part of this bridge.
rate_year_basis: The donor dollar year: the pinned populace-us support artifact has survey period 2024 (source_stages.json artifact vintage "2024"; spec/vintages.yaml nz_support_pool_2024_buildp).
